text: 2026-08-03 checkpoint: the public DMS slice is now registered as fit.dms-multiphase-50-columns.v1 and passes its focused JVM/JS tests. It also found and fixed a source-confirmed semantic-loss bug in DesignSchema.combine: event provenance was omitted from the combined audit/fingerprint. The regression passes DesignSchemaSuite 11/11 on JVM and JS. This advances P3.1/P3.2 but does not close them: external design/fit receipts, planted-effect numerical assertions, realistic nuisance, AR/censor, executable documentation, and release gates remain open.
